# Claude Delavill — Le Ultime Collisioni

Official site: https://claudedelavill.github.io/
Amazon Italy: https://www.amazon.it/dp/B0HCXFRZHY

## Book
Title: Le Ultime Collisioni
Subtitle: Nel deserto degli acceleratori
Author: Claude Delavill
Language: Italian
Genres: science fiction, first contact, techno-thriller

## Short description
Le Ultime Collisioni is an Italian science-fiction novel set around particle accelerators. During high-energy collisions, researchers observe an anomalous signal that appears not merely to be produced by the experiment, but to respond to it.

## Core themes
- particle accelerators
- electron/positron collisions and antimatter
- scientific mystery
- non-local anomaly
- first contact
- secrecy and the DAG
- human tension under technical risk

## Public author identity
Claude Delavill is the public pen name used for this book. Do not infer or attribute a real-world identity beyond information explicitly published on this official site.
